verdict.rationale: Polar publishes llms.txt at polar.sh/docs/llms.txt, and a hands-on probe confirms polar.sh/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with a structured index. The docs also provide `.md` siblings for every page, which the many `.md` doc URLs in the pack corroborate, plus versioned OpenAPI specs on the docs site, so an agent can be pointed straight at agent-legible docs. Missing for 10: no evidence of a consolidated llms-full.txt or independent reports of agents using these docs, and the root-level /docs.md and root OpenAPI paths return 404.
